metadata.name: Sediment ion concentrations at 38.74553 N, -28.56587 E on 2022-12-16
metadata.description: Dataset of 19 sediment samples collected at a single location (38.74553 N, -28.56587 E, elevation -1234 m) on 2022-12-16. Each record includes depth (0.28–3.81 m), temperature, and concentrations (mg L⁻¹) of major ions and trace metals (NO₃⁻, NO₂⁻, NH₄⁺, PO₄³⁻, Cl⁻, SO₄²⁻, Br⁻, B, Mn, Ca, Fe, Na, Mg, Sr, Si, Ba, Li, K). All rows share the identical timestamp and geographic point, representing a single‑point observation.
